  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"Only R03 holds: issuing-country/IP mismatch plus failed address verification establishes the Card family. No other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Row §6.6(b) initially required id_check; its completed failure now mandates decline under §5.3(b). Linkage is absent, so escalation is prohibited. Travel is a plausible benign explanation for geography and address-verification failure, but it cannot override the failed check. No installments were due, so non-payment supplies no evidence. The order remains unshipped and uncancelled; decline would void and refund it and block the account. No further check would change the prescribed disposition."
